scripts.test:regression: npm run lint --workspaces && npm test --workspaces && npm run build --workspaces && npm run test:e2e:ci --workspace api
scripts.check-updates: echo '--- webapp ---' && npx npm-check-updates --packageFile webapp/package.json --format group && echo '' && echo '--- api ---' && npx npm-check-updates --packageFile api/package.json --format group
scripts.check-updates:json: npx npm-check-updates --packageFile webapp/package.json --jsonAll && npx npm-check-updates --packageFile api/package.json --jsonAll
scripts.upgrade:patch: npx npm-check-updates --packageFile webapp/package.json --target patch -u && npx npm-check-updates --packageFile api/package.json --target patch -u
scripts.upgrade:minor: npx npm-check-updates --packageFile webapp/package.json --target minor -u && npx npm-check-updates --packageFile api/package.json --target minor -u
